programs.description: Matt and Jake, two junior executives working at Hampton DeVille, a soulless multinational corporation, try to survive and navigate their workplace.
The daughter of a teen mother, Jane Villanueva grows up determined not to repeat her mum's mistakes. At 23, her life is on track, but a routine clinic visit flips it upside down.
Dexter is presumed dead and living a homicide-free life under an alias when his son shows up. Thrown off balance, Dexter soon finds his Dark Passenger has very dangerous company in Iron Lake.

Dexter Morgan, a man with murderous impulses, leads a double life. He works as a forensic technician for the police department during the day and kills heinous criminals in his free time.
A brilliant legal mind with an eccentric approach, Elsbeth Tascioni navigates New York's crime scene, offering unique insights that challenge traditional investigations.

A sex columnist, Carrie Bradshaw, and her three friends -- Samantha, Charlotte and Miranda -- explore Manhattan's dating scene, chronicling the mating habits of single New Yorkers. Not surprisingly, the ladies have a number of beaus throughout the series' run.

Sherlock, a recovering drug addict, and Joan Watson, a former surgeon hired to aid Sherlock in his rehabilitation, help the New York Police Department solve difficult crimes.

When their respective marriages fall apart, endearing slob Oscar Madison invites his former college friend Felix Unger to move in with him. Right away it becomes obvious that Felix's uptight, neat-freak ways are at odds with his habits, so Oscar worries he has made an enormous mistake, but together they decide that -- whatever their differences -- they can help each other move on from their divorces, make the living arrangement work and, possibly, learn a little more about themselves in the process.
